title: Adobe Commerce pricing - GMV-tiered enterprise license
clean_text: Adobe Commerce license fees are GMV-based and not publicly listed. On-premise license starts around $22,000/year for merchants under $1M GMV, scaling to $125,000+/year for $25M+ GMV. Adobe Commerce Cloud (managed hosting included) starts around $40,000/year, scaling to approximately $190,000/year at enterprise tier. Total cost of ownership including development, hosting, and support typically runs 2 to 3 times the license fee alone.
